description: Return the complete repository-analysis/v1 bundle: every project audit with per-target test evidence plus the derived summary, findings, ranking, plan, execution hints, and stats. The result grows with repository size and can exceed client limits on large monorepos, so prefer review_repository first and use this only when the complete bundle is explicitly needed or the repository is small.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before analysis.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root. Keys are detected project roots.

name: analyze_repository

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/repository-analysis-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Analyze Repository
